email.body1:
Jerome, saw Incode acquire AuthenticID and launch its agentic AI authentication framework.

Moves that big usually put more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before the new capabilities land, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Incode off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jerome, quick follow-up for Incode.

After an acquisition and a new framework launch, the number on pipeline tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Incode needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Jerome, last bit of proof for Incode.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Incode's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Incode either way.
